world_model_delta: Conquest may be a chain step (CLAIM quest type). If conquest window fails (score threshold not met), CLAIM step is marked FAILED but chain persists — next attempt costs 50% more resources. Failed conquest does not create retroactive resource liability.
validator_question: Does a failed conquest chain step create retroactive liability for resources spent?
risk_of_symbol_smuggling: LOW — failed step costs only the failed attempt; no retroactive liability
